tasks.name: prometheus-query
tasks.description: Query Prometheus metrics, including Kubernetes metrics, using PromQL. Examples: up, node_cpu_seconds_total, kube_pod_info. Do not pass shell commands such as kubectl.

query.description: A PromQL expression, not a shell command. Example: rate(node_cpu_seconds_total[5m]).

tasks.name: prometheus-query-range
tasks.description: Query historical Prometheus metrics for an explicit incident time range. Requires timezone-aware start_time and end_time; never infer an absent timezone. Read-only, maximum 24 hours, 300 evaluation points per series and 10 returned series. Use a larger step for longer ranges; results may be limited by Prometheus retention and series limits.

query.description: A PromQL expression, not a shell command. Example: rate(http_requests_total[5m]).

start_time.description: Inclusive start with timezone, for example 2026-11-03T09:07:00Z or 2026-11-03T14:37:00+05:30.

end_time.description: Inclusive end with timezone, after start_time and at most 24 hours later.

step_seconds.description: Seconds between evaluation points. At most 300 inclusive evaluation points; increase this for longer windows.

tasks.name: kubernetes-pods
tasks.description: List pod names and status in one namespace; no cluster changes.

tasks.name: jira-issue-search
tasks.description: Search Jira issues using a read-only JQL query.
